issueHelp.bind_missing: Docker creates an empty folder in its place: if it was meant to be a file (a configuration) the container won't find it.
issueHelp.container_name_replicas: A fixed name is valid for one container only.
issueHelp.depends_cycle: docker compose cannot decide the start order.
issueHelp.depends_not_ready: A database takes a few seconds to accept connections: with a healthcheck and condition: service_healthy the app gets no connection errors at startup.
issueHelp.docker_socket: The container can control the whole Docker of the machine.
issueHelp.env_missing: Add it to the .env next to the file or give it a default with ${{name}:-value}.
issueHelp.env_required: docker compose stops until it is set.
issueHelp.healthy_without_healthcheck: Without a healthcheck (in the file or the image) up fails.
issueHelp.image_latest: latest changes over time: a pull can bring a new version (for databases, even one incompatible with the data).
issueHelp.port_all_interfaces: Anyone on the same network (Wi-Fi included) reaches the service: 127.0.0.1 limits it to this machine.
issueHelp.port_duplicate: The second service does not start: "port is already allocated".
issueHelp.port_in_use: Up of this service fails until the port is free: change it or stop the other process.
issueHelp.secret_plain: If the file goes into the repository, so does the secret: better ${{name}} with the value in the .env (ignored by git).
issueHelp.version_obsolete: Compose v2 no longer uses it and warns about it on every command.
